notes: «ح» separates two branches; the names after the last ح (from أبي عامر on) are written once, so they are the shared tail.
«- قال أبو داود وهذا لفظ ابن بشار -» is the compiler's gloss, left out.
«قال أخبرنا ابن أبي مليكة» at the end restates the same link in Ibn Bashshar's wording: a wording remark, not a route.
Aisha is the last link; the Prophet's words follow.
